u0: The siren has not yet triggered the switch-flip obligation. Continue monitoring the siren; toggling the switch before it rings does not satisfy the task or advance this state. When siren_ringing first becomes true, move to u1 and begin the switch subtask.
u1: The siren has rung and the required switch toggle has not yet occurred afterward. The active objective is to reach the wall switch and toggle it at least once; a switch_toggled event now completes the requirement and transitions to u2. Until then, remain in this unresolved state.
u2: The switch has been toggled after the siren rang, so the requirement is satisfied. This is the absorbing success terminal state: remain here, with no further siren-related switch obligation.
